records.title: SMBs repeatedly ask for WhatsApp order handling
records.text: Three separate mentor-program founders this week described wanting a way to log orders that come in over WhatsApp without re-typing them into a spreadsheet. All three run small home-based product businesses.

records.title: Request for a low-stock email alert
records.text: A user of Orderly asked whether the app could email them when a product's stock count drops below the threshold, instead of only showing an in-app badge.
